${mod_id}.modmenu.group.main.name: Main
${mod_id}.modmenu.option.mod_enabled.des: If enabled, you will see particles in your inventory from cursor with an item; if disabled, won't.
${mod_id}.modmenu.option.debug_mode_enab: If enabled, you will see some debug info; if disabled, won't.
${mod_id}.modmenu.option.nbt_debug_mode_: If enabled, you will some debug info about item nbt in game logs; if disabled, won't.
${mod_id}.modmenu.group.global_section.d: Global settings for all contexts. They will be applied additionally to context-specific settings.
${mod_id}.modmenu.group.cursor_section.d: Particles that will be spawned around the cursor when an item is held.
${mod_id}.modmenu.group.hovered_slot_sec: Particles that will be spawned around the slot currently under the cursor.
${mod_id}.modmenu.group.gui_slots_sectio: Particles that will be spawned in every GUI slots with items.
${mod_id}.modmenu.group.gui_actions_sect: Particles that will be spawned after any GUI actions (e.g. take, put, quick-move, etc).
${mod_id}.modmenu.option.spawn_enabled.d: If enabled, particles will be spawned for this context; if disabled, won't.
${mod_id}.modmenu.option.gui_action_take: If enabled, particles will be spawned when taking items from slots; if disabled, won't.
${mod_id}.modmenu.option.gui_action_put_: If enabled, particles will be spawned when putting items into slots; if disabled, won't.
${mod_id}.modmenu.option.gui_action_quic: If enabled, particles will be spawned when quick moving items (with Shift + LMB); if disabled, won't.
${mod_id}.modmenu.option.count_coefficie: Multiplier for the count of particles that can be spawned in this context.
${mod_id}.modmenu.option.cooldown_coeffi: Multiplier for the cooldown between particles spawns in this context.
${mod_id}.modmenu.option.spawn_chance.de: Chance (not cooldown) of particles spawning after some GUI actions (e.g. take/put).
Controls how the whitelist will be applied. Whitelist — only items in the whitelist will spawn particles; Blacklist — items in the whitelist won't spawn particles.
${mod_id}.modmenu.option.whitelist_items: Write item ids here. You can take it from item's tooltip (with F3 + H enabled). Use space to separate ids.
${mod_id}.modmenu.group.visual.name: Visual
${mod_id}.modmenu.option.particles_delet: Controls which particles will be removed for spawn new particles if the maximum particle limit has been reached.
${mod_id}.modmenu.option.particles_count: Controls how many particles can exits on the screen.
${mod_id}.modmenu.option.particles_trans: Controls transparency of all particles on the screen.
${mod_id}.modmenu.option.fade_out_durati: Duration in ticks for smooth particle fade out effect after reaching the maximum particle limit. If set to 0, particles will be removed immediately without fading.
${mod_id}.modmenu.group.cache.name: Modded Items Cache
${mod_id}.modmenu.group.cache.descriptio: Settings controlling cached assets used for modded items.

${mod_id}.particles_linking.title: Linking Particles To Items
${mod_id}.notice_message_2_1_0:
§a[${mod_name}]§e Hello %s§e! A small, but important message:§r

§rInventory Particles now has native support for items from other mods!

How it works: The mod takes items and creates particle textures for them. This can take some time depending on the number of modded items in the game §e(right now there %s§e!).§r

To see the progress, open your inventory and hover in the upper-right corner.

If you have a slow PC, you may experience a slight frame drop during the generation. This is normal and will only happen once!

Once complete, everything will be cached/saved and load very quickly.

To clear the cache or change its behaviour, open the mod's settings menu.

§eThank you for your attention! This message will not appear again.
